summary: Simulate a congestion-aware retry mechanism with shared spin-credit tracking and implicit error handling.

traps.quote: run-length encoded chronological list... run counts are at most `10^18`
traps.consequence: Expanding runs into an array causes memory/time explosion; algorithm becomes infeasible.
traps.guard: Process outcomes implicitly with run index and offset; never expand run counts.

traps.consequence: Computing 2^59 or overflow produces wrong spin/yield counts without arbitrary precision.
traps.guard: Use full-precision arithmetic; compute 2^old_level directly for all comparisons and sums.

traps.quote: After all runs are exhausted, every later attempt implicitly returns `error`.
traps.consequence: Retry loops fail to terminate; infinite loops or wrong attempt counts.
traps.guard: Track outcome position; return implicit error when past last run; count these attempts.

traps.quote: packet is dropped immediately; that final 'full' causes no spin, yield, or credit deduction
traps.consequence: If conditions fail, credits/spins still deducted; level incorrectly reverts for next packets.
traps.guard: Check both conditions before any side effect; drop immediately if either fails; level persists.

traps.quote: 'error' fails the packet and resets the level to zero. Credits are unchanged.
traps.consequence: Incorrect final credits if they are reset on error instead of persisting.
traps.guard: On error: reset level only; never modify credits. Credits change only on 'ok' or 'full'.

traps.quote: retries have already been scheduled for this packet ... max_retries applies per packet
traps.consequence: Global retry limit applied instead of per-packet; vastly more retries than intended.
traps.guard: Track retry_count per packet; check retry_count < max_retries for each packet independently.

input_shape: Seven parameters: packet lengths (up to 200k), run-length encoded outcomes (up to 200k runs with counts 10^18), retry/level/spin limits, credit range.
output_shape: Dictionary with 'packets' (status, retries, spins, yields per packet) and 'telemetry' (counters plus final level/credits).
invariants: Each packet ends with exactly one status: INVALID, SENT, ERROR, or DROPPED.
Level always in [0, level_cap]; credits always in [0, credit_cap].
Retries are per-packet; max_retries applies individually, not globally.
max_scale: 200k packets; 200k outcome runs with 10^18 counts; level_cap 60; credit_cap 10^30.
